description: The Figma kit of each scheme (OD-149): variables in every theme, text and effect styles, foundations, the components that have component keys, and a page with every question and answer. Generated by scripts/figma-kit.mjs from the scheme; the site links to these files from each scheme page.
plugin: The Open DS kits Figma plugin is generated, not committed: pnpm figma-kit all writes figma/plugin, and every GitHub release has open-ds-kits-plugin.zip attached. In Figma desktop: Plugins, Development, Import plugin from manifest, pick plugin/manifest.json, then run it in a kit file.
